# Q1: Titanic Data Analysis Pipeline

### a) Data Import and Structure
```{r}
url <- "[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasciencedojo/datasets/master/titanic.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasciencedojo/datasets/master/titanic.csv)"
titanic <- read.csv(url)
str(titanic)
summary(titanic)
```

### b) Handling Missing Values
```{r}
# Check for NAs
colSums(is.na(titanic))

# Handling Age with Median (Robust to outliers)
titanic$Age[is.na(titanic$Age)] <- median(titanic$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
```

### c) Transformation & Feature Engineering
```{r}
# Convert to factors
titanic$Survived <- as.factor(titanic$Survived)
titanic$Pclass <- as.factor(titanic$Pclass)

# Derived Feature: FamilySize
titanic$FamilySize <- titanic$SibSp + titanic$Parch + 1
```

# Q6: Machine Learning Pipeline (mtcars)

### Model Development
```{r}
library(caret)
set.seed(123)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(mtcars$mpg, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
trainData <- mtcars[trainIndex, ]
testData  <- mtcars[-trainIndex, ]

model <- lm(mpg ~ wt + hp + cyl, data = trainData)
summary(model)
```
"""
